name: check_plan_completeness
description: Checks a plan document (markdown string) for the required Tidepool plan sections and explicit-exclusion language; returns a list of missing requirements. Call when validating a plan.md before delivery.

example.markdown:
# Tidepool Plan
Scoop decision: re-scope the scoop. Demos pass/fail pre-registered at 72 fps, comfort %, clarity, fun. PRD, core loop, exclusions list. Monetisation $14.99 US, JPY 2200 Japan, EUR 14.99 Germany, BRL 59.90 Brazil. three.js WebXR architecture. Fun proxies with real-players-needed caveat. Localisation en/ja/de/pt-BR, CJK handling, externalised strings. Store route: Horizon Store New Tab Page, https://developers.meta.com/ sources, unverified items flagged, target regions US Japan Germany Brazil. Milestones M0-M4. Risks and mitigations. Feasibility sign-off.
